title: TEST FIXTURE: official-notice style excerpt composed strictly from AP article facts
text: NOTICE (TEST FIXTURE, composed only from facts stated in the AP source article; no external facts added). Effective Saturday August 22, additional duties of 50% apply to scores of Canadian imports covering approximately $20 billion in goods, including hockey sticks, agricultural products, wine, cement, honey, seeds, makeup, perfumes, clothing, jewelry, furniture, cameras, and fabric. Authority: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930. Canada announced dollar for dollar countermeasures beginning Sept. 8. A further increase on Canadian cars, trucks, automotive parts and steel to 50% starting Jan. 1, 2027 has been threatened but is not in effect.
